description: Intake resolver for a single merchant inside a marketplace: given EITHER os_client_id OR merchant_id as a filter, returns the merchant's os_client_id, merchant_id and merchant_name. Use it to normalise a user-supplied merchant reference before any merchant-scoped analysis - the two id spaces are different (os_client_id is the advertiser client, merchant_id is the seller id used in the category and merchant fact tables) and must never be interchanged. Point-in-time dimension lookup: no date window applies. Filter on exactly one id attribute; requesting it unfiltered returns the whole merchant directory for the agency. No real metrics - a placeholder_metric is included to satisfy the fetch layer.

merchant_id.description: Seller id of the merchant - the id used by the category and merchant fact tables. Filter on this when the user supplied a merchant_id / seller_id.

os_client_id.description: Advertiser client id of the merchant - the id used by campaign, SKU and keyword reports. Filter on this when the user supplied an os_client_id.

merchant_name.description: Human-readable merchant / seller name, for confirming the resolved merchant back to the user.

placeholder_metric.description: Constant 0 - a required placeholder metric so the fetch layer accepts this pure-attribute lookup report; not a real measure.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.monetize_merchant_dimensions` AS mmd WHERE mmd.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
